annotations.text:
REFINED REGISTER (leading)
Closer to what ships today — same register pattern, airier row rhythm, a white Style=Table header, and a light findings stat bar. Lowest-risk evolution.

CARD FEED
Each agent and finding is its own card. Trades density for scannability — the open-findings count reads as a big number, findings expand in place with pill-style record chips.

DENSE OPS CONSOLE
Maximum rows per screen for a power user working the queue all day. Dark mono header, status dots instead of colored text, monospace ids and dollar amounts.
